g.text: A slanted line drawn across is labelled with its x at y 40, the top of the ink.
The monogram is bar-monogram: MONOGRAM_RECTS skewed by x − y tan 12° (SKEW) about y 0, with CUT = [96, 104] (Prototemplate
The name: GENERAL TRANSLATION in Michroma (michroma-400.woff2) at size 24, cap height 18 (capHeight 1536 of 2048 units in michroma-400.woff2).
Its cap line is gap = 46 below the monogram's bottom, at y 206, and its baseline at y 224.
The L's stem is 192 and its foot 160 of 2048 units: 2.25 and 1.875 at size 24.
Of the name's level edges the cap line, the baseline and the top of the E's bottom bar and the L's foot (y 222.125, 160 units above the baseline) are drawn;
the other letters' bars, bowls and overshoots are the font's shapes and are left out.
Letter-spaced by (MONO.w − its advance) / 18 = 3.85, so its advance equals the monogram's width MONO.w = 491.58, from x −105.08 to 386.5, and
These labels are the generator's values where the path, written to one decimal, reads otherwise (its reading in brackets): -58.5 (-58.49), -28.5 (-28.51),
91.5 (91.51), 216.5 (216.49), 386.5 (386.49). The letters' edges and the widths between them carry the font's values: each glyph's outline in font units ×
size / unitsPerEm, placed as type() places it; the path writes them to one decimal (222.125 is written 222.1).
